Single long scrollytelling page, no top nav, progress is a clock or meter only
Three rooms linked like a small apartment: foyer / kitchen / window. No global nav
Deck of 7 full-bleed cards. Visitor sees one. A control advances. No scroll
Switchboard: a directory of 8 labeled buttons. Each opens a monologue, then returns
Timeline rail on the left, 5 stations, content locked to the selected year
Inbox parody: the story is a thread of 6 messages. Latest on top
Map with 5 pins only. Clicking a pin is the only way forward. No list view
Form that is the story: each field submitted reveals the next paragraph
Two-column court record: left is evidence, right is testimony, they disagree
Day-in-the-life broken into clock hours. Skipping ahead is allowed, back is not
Museum audio-guide pages 1–6. A transcript is visible. Images are exhibit plates
Choose-almost-nothing: one binary choice at the midpoint, both end at the same last page
Receipt printer: the page grows a new line every few seconds. Print stylesheet required
Window and street: desktop split. Interior monologue left, public signage right
Index card box: 12 cards, shuffle button allowed, reading order is not canonical
Loading-gate: a slow first screen is content, not a spinner. Then one article
Chorus and verse: home is a refrain that returns between 4 inner pages
Dossier envelope: table of contents with classification stamps, 5 files
Bus route: stops listed. Each stop is a short scene. End of the line is credits
Single viewport play: no scroll, no click except one 'continue' key. Five beats
Tabbed counter: 4 service windows. Only one is open. The other three show 'next' times
Voicemail stack: 5 recordings with durations. Play one at a time. Transcript optional
Checklist that is the plot: 9 boxes. Checking one reveals a consequence, not a reward
Floorplan: click a room. Hallways are copy. You cannot skip the corridor text
Shift handover log: three overlapping notes from three clerks about the same hour
Photo booth strip: 4 frames stacked, captions under each, one strip only
Radio preset bar: 6 stations. Switching mid-sentence is allowed. The story continues on the new station
Lost-property ledger: rows you can expand. One row is empty on purpose
Staircase: 8 landings. You may go down. Going up returns you two landings, never to the start
Split receipt: visitor and merchant copies side by side, same items, different notes
Kiosk wizard: back/next only, 6 steps, cancel is labeled but does nothing
Noticeboard: overlapping flyers. Z-order is the reading order. A pin is the only control
Queue ticket display: now serving N. Content is whoever is being served. N advances on a timer
Glossary that becomes a story: 10 defined terms. Definitions contain the only narrative
Two tabs only: BEFORE and AFTER. Neither is labeled with dates. The difference is the plot
Envelope / letter / enclosure: three layers. You open inward. Closing is optional
